records.name: Reusable inspection kit
records.description: A trace card, ordinary inspection light and training length readout in one satchel pouch. Quantity: 1. Use it on the labeled physical path; the instrument reports only the supplied fictional exercise. It cannot certify cabling, repair a broken conductor, supply power or prove an application service. Development text/icon reference only.

acquisition.explanation: Your satchel is always reachable. ACTION-take-kit or Photon's first topic applies the same EFFECT-kit + EFFECT-kit-issued batch with the same FLAG-kit-issued receipt. Either path grants exactly one; replay never adds another.

recovery.explanation: Using or changing the training path never consumes this kit. Taking it is free and always available before acquisition; no side quest, ally, account or one-way exit is required. Retry restores preparation inventory; subsequent dialogue cannot duplicate an issued kit.
